externalRootsNote: The inventory records no external root. This is the measured state, not an omission: the only recorded root is the A10 test-only HMAC-SHA256 key, which is symmetric and same-party and therefore cannot establish independence.

producer.note: the A10 envelopes were produced inside this candidate

roots.independenceBasis: none: the key is derived from a fixed public seed recorded inside the candidate tree; the signer and the verifier hold the same secret, so the verifier could have produced the signature

samePartyNote: The single root is recorded with trustDomain 'same-party' and symmetric: true so that the refusal is visible in the inventory itself.
